images.caption: Transmitter facility for WOUB-FM/TV in Athens, Ohio. This building is located on a dirt road off of Ohio Route 56 just west of Athens. At the time this photo was taken the building was staffed for the entire broadcast day, from 6:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m.
